Vendors and Manufacturer Documentation
======================================

Keep a component record with the manufacturer, exact model, documentation
link, firmware version where applicable, and the team member responsible.
Use the instructions for the actual component revision installed on the robot.

Documentation starting points
-----------------------------

* `REV Robotics documentation <https://docs.revrobotics.com/>`_
* `CTRE documentation <https://docs.ctr-electronics.com/>`_
* `AndyMark <https://www.andymark.com/>`_
* `West Coast Products <https://wcproducts.com/>`_

These links are a starting directory. Check the current official rules and
manufacturer specifications when evaluating a component for a competition robot.
